fields.v: Tuning (per repository, 3-5 iterations of ~22 single-shot LLM calls, no agent loop or tools): 1 generate 10 synthetic bug-fix probes (temperature 0.9, deduplicated); 2 attempt a fix per probe; 3 judge each attempt and propose edits; 4 aggregate, merge, cap at 5 edits, apply mechanically and trim to 3,000 chars; stop after two iterations without change. Use: guidance given to a fixed ReAct-style coding agent that resolves the issue; single-shot fallback if no patch within the step budget; patches sanitised and evaluated by the SWE-bench harness

fields.v:
Metric: SWE-bench Verified hidden tests (resolve rate, 500 instances); coverage and precision; cost only as relative prompt tokens. The authors state no success threshold (they stress the relative comparison, absolute rates being low by design, p. 4), so no verdict is given. Agent = authors' ReAct-style bash scaffold (unnamed, released code), 16k effective context, temperature 0. Values: resolve / coverage / precision, mean +- SD of 4 trials at 200 steps unless noted.
Main experiment (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, 200 steps, 4 trials; Tables 4, 8):
- no_context (baseline) + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 25.5 +- 2.2% / 41.7 +- 2.9% / 61.0 +- 2.6%; fallback 25.6%; tokens 2.3x at 200 vs 25 steps. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- static_kb + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 28.3 +- 1.4% / 50.6 +- 2.3% / 56.0 +- 2.5%; fallback 30.8%. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors (one-off generation per repository, not quantified)
- probe_refined + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 33.0 +- 1.8% / 56.2 +- 1.8% / 58.6 +- 1.6%; fallback 14.8%; ~56% more prompt tokens than no_context; tokens 2.8x at 200 vs 25 steps; tuning 3-5 iterations x ~22 calls of ~8k/2k tokens per repository (one-off). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
Step-budget runs (Qwen, single trial; Table 9), resolve at 25 / 50 / 100 steps:
- no_context: 24.4 / 27.6 / 23.6%
- static_kb: 21.8 / 29.8 / 29.6%
- probe_refined: 24.2 / 23.4 / 30.8% (below static_kb at 50 steps, p=0.022)
- Quality and cost for all: no criterion stated by the authors
Cross-model (NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, 200 steps, single trial; Tables 11-12):
- no_context + own scaffold + Nemotron: 28.4% (142 resolved). Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- static_kb + own scaffold + Nemotron: 24.6%. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- probe_refined (Nemotron-tuned) + own scaffold + Nemotron: 27.0% (135); tuning loop degraded (3.8 of 5 iterations); 351 agent-loop patches, 3 fallback, 39.2 steps per instance, 11 hit max steps; agent-loop precision 38.5%. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- probe_refined (Qwen-tuned, transferred) + own scaffold + Nemotron: 13.2% (66); 174 agent-loop patches, 324 fallback patches (none resolved); 81.0 steps per instance, 83 hit max steps; agent-loop precision 37.9%. Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (the authors call it a 'collapse', p. 16)

fields.v: Tasks: SWE-bench Verified 500 instances. Configurations: 3 guidance conditions x Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (4 trials at 200 steps; single trials at 25/50/100 steps) and x Nemotron (single trial, plus Qwen-to-Nemotron transfer). Baseline: no_context. Held constant: scaffold, model within experiment, harness, 16k context, 2,048 output tokens per turn, output truncation ~3,000 chars, temperature 0 (0.9 for probes), same hardware; guidance tuned with the consuming model. Acceptance: SWE-bench held-out tests. Repetitions: 4 (main), 1 (others). Human intervention: none. Statistics: mixed-effects logistic regression (instance and trial random effects, n=6,000), per-trial McNemar, Wilson CIs

fields.v: Qwen, 200 steps: probe_refined 33.0% > static_kb 28.3% > no_context 25.5% in 4/4 trials; mixed-effects OR 2.11 (vs no_context, p<0.001), 1.58 (vs static_kb, p<0.001), static_kb vs no_context OR 1.34 (p=0.004). Gain of 7.5 pp = 2.8 static_kb + 4.7 refinement. Coverage +14.5 pp; precision not significantly different (p=0.119). Unique consistent solves 31 vs 8 (no_context) vs 4 (static_kb); easy core 65, hard core 342. Effect present for Django (27.7/31.2/35.3%) and non-Django (23.5/25.8/30.9%). Budget: all equal at 25 steps; no_context flat; probe_refined only one rising beyond 100 steps. Nemotron: ordering reversed (28.4 > 27.0 > 24.6%); Qwen-tuned guidance collapses Nemotron to 13.2%

fields.v: Distinguished conditions at 200 steps with 4 trials (consistent ordering, significant); budget and cross-model results single-trial, descriptive. Limitations stated: guidance length confound (refined 63% longer; padding/truncation ablations not run); localization hypothesis not causally tested (file-structure ablation not run); one model able to run the procedure; loop prompts tuned to Qwen; no probe/seed sensitivity analysis; single benchmark with Django concentration; contamination cannot be ruled out; constrained pipeline (16k context) gives low absolute rates
